  SELECT DISTINCT process_guid, command_line
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE pid = 5576
    AND time >= '2022-07-18 21:04:38'
    AND (pname = 'cmd.exe' OR process_name LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' OR command_line = 'C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /c ""C:\Users\aalsahee\Desktop\run_http_server.bat" "')
), candidates AS (
  SELECT a.*,
         CASE
           WHEN a.ppid = 5576 THEN 'ppid=5576'
           WHEN a.parent_process_guid IN (SELECT process_guid FROM target WHERE process_guid IS NOT NULL) THEN 'parent_process_guid'
           WHEN a.parent_command_line = 'C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /c ""C:\Users\aalsahee\Desktop\run_http_server.bat" "' THEN 'parent_command_line'
           WHEN a.pid = 5576 THEN 'pid=5576'
         END AS edge_basis
  FROM audit_logs a
  WHERE a.time >= '2022-07-18 21:04:38'
    AND (
      a.pid = 5576
      OR a.ppid = 5576
      OR a.parent_process_guid IN (SELECT process_guid FROM target WHERE process_guid IS NOT NULL)
